digest.component_or_area: Git ref reclamation and backup preparation
propositions: A helper script must enumerate live origin heads and tags at runtime without hardcoded counts, collapse annotated-tag peeled refs onto canonical forms, and record exact direct and peeled OIDs with one ancestry relationship per commit

The helper must refuse partial/promisor clones and pre-existing refs/reclaim-backup/ refs, create an invocation-unique namespace for temporary refs, and remove only that namespace on success or caught failure
The helper must create a verified bundle containing the old tickets tip and requested pin refs, and verify restoration into a throwaway repository reproduces exact OIDs without any remote mutations
Output artifacts (bundle and manifest) must not be created inside the repository, Git directory, or registered worktrees, and must never overwrite pre-existing files
A caught bundle verification failure or pre-existing helper ref must result in nonzero exit with cleanup of incomplete artifacts and current-run refs, remediating by fresh unfiltered clone
Remote heads and tags snapshots must remain byte-identical before and after successful completion, confirming no push, delete, or remote ref mutation occurred
